statements.t: We are raising both our revenue and adjusted EBITDA guidance for 2026, reflecting the strong momentum in our business,” said Sean Brynjelsen, CEO of Eton Pharmaceuticals.
The Company expects continued organic growth from these products through the remainder of 2026 and beyond.
The Company anticipates dosing the first patients in the coming months.
The Company is on track to submit an NDA near the end of 2026 or early 2027, allowing for potential approval and launch in 2027.
The Company now expects 2026 revenue of more than $175 million, an increase from its previous guidance of more than $145 million.
The Company also expects at least a 40% Adjusted EBITDA margin for 2026, up from its previous guidance of at least 35%.
The Company expects full-year 2026 adjusted gross margin to exceed 70%.
In addition to taking live questions from participants on the conference call, management will be answering emailed questions from investors.

Significant Financing Component – In determining the transaction price, we will adjust consideration for the effects of the time value of money if the expected period between payment by the licensees and the transfer of the promised goods or services to the licensees will be more than one year.

This allocation requires management to make significant estimates and assumptions, including the selection of valuation methodologies, discount rates, projected cash flows, and useful lives of acquired assets.

estimates.name: Acquisitions
estimates.t: Under this method of accounting, assets acquired and liabilities assumed are recorded at their respective fair values at the date of the acquisition.

estimates.name: Stock-Based Compensation
estimates.t: The guidance under ASC 718 requires companies to estimate the fair value of the stock-based compensation awards on the date of grant and record expense over the related service periods, which are generally the vesting period of the equity awards.
